restore.filesAndTaskHint: Restores your project's files and deletes all messages after this point.

notice.no-previous: No earlier checkpoint to compare against.

panel.acceptAllTooltip: Accept every change — keep them and stop tracking
panel.revertTooltip: Revert this file to the state it was in before this task

view.title: Worktrees
view.description: A worktree is a second checkout of this repository on another branch. Each task can run in its own, so two agents never edit the same files.
view.noWorkspace: No folder is open. Open the repository you want worktrees for.
view.notGitRepo: This workspace is not a Git repository. Open a workspace with a Git repository to use worktrees.
view.multiRootNotSupported: Worktrees are not supported in multi-root workspaces. Open a single folder to use them.
view.subfolderNotSupported: This workspace is a subfolder of a Git repository. Open the repository root to use worktrees.
view.includeFileExists: .shofer/worktreeinclude found. Its files are copied into new worktrees.

picker.disabledNotGitRepo: Worktrees unavailable: workspace is not a git repository
picker.disabledSubfolder: Worktrees unavailable: workspace is a subfolder of a git repository
picker.disabledNoFolder: Worktrees unavailable: no workspace folder open

create.title: Create Worktree
create.noIncludeFileHint: Worktrees are created with just the files from their branch. To copy over local files like .env and node_modules, list them in .shofer/worktreeinclude at the root of the repository.

delete.title: Delete Worktree
delete.warning: This can't be undone. It will delete:
delete.warningBranch: The branch and any uncommitted changes
delete.warningFiles: All files in the worktree directory
delete.noticeLarge: If this is a large repository, it may take a little while.
